SCAN.SCAN_INSTRUCTION: Please scan your ID card in the designated area below

DETAILS.SUBTITLE:
Please verify that the displayed details are correct
and take a photo if none exists in the system

SIGNATURE.READ_AND_SIGN: Please read the form and sign to approve the visit terms.
SIGNATURE.SIGN_WITH_FINGER: Please sign using your finger or stylus
SIGNATURE.CLEAR_NOTE: You can clear and sign again

COMPLETE.SUCCESS_MESSAGE:
Your details were successfully registered.
Please continue your visit according to site instructions.
COMPLETE.HOST_NOTIFIED: Your host has been notified of your arrival.
COMPLETE.WAIT_IN_LOBBY: Please wait in the lobby until you are called.
COMPLETE.NEED_HELP: If you need assistance, please contact the reception staff.

ERROR.TITLE: Something Went Wrong
ERROR.NO_ID_DETECTED_IN_SCAN: No ID number was detected in the scanned document.
ERROR.DOCUMENT_SCAN_ERROR: An error occurred while scanning the document. Please try again.
ERROR.SCANNED_ID_NOT_MATCH: The scanned ID does not match the expected ID.
ERROR.GENERAL_TRY_AGAIN: An error occurred. Please try again later.

INVITATION.NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE: We could not find an active invitation based on the entered details.
INVITATION.CHECK_CODE: Please verify the invitation code was entered correctly
INVITATION.MAYBE_NOT_CREATED: The invitation may not yet exist or may be scheduled for another date
INVITATION.TRY_AGAIN_OR_CANCEL: Try again or press Cancel to return to the home screen
INVITATION.RECEPTION_HELP: Reception staff can verify the invitation and help you continue.
